name: Finance · OneDrive Finance Evidence Root · Manual Setup

parameters.content:
## Manual OneDrive root setup

Creates exactly one top-level `Finance Evidence` folder only when it is absent. It reads the drive root before and after the decision, refuses case variants or non-folder conflicts, and fails if a nested `Finance Evidence/Finance Evidence` folder exists.

The final receipt omits the folder ID, drive metadata, credential values, URLs, and file contents. This workflow must remain inactive and must never be scheduled.
